name: hsm_smvm_wrq_t_r4
purpose: H-SM 2026-10-16: hardened SM result -> VM writer smw_<q>, ONE master for the 4 instances (option A wrapper: folded ot_static_cmd_target MODE 1 command calendar CW 26 + 128x256 table, tgt strap; quad strap replaces parameter QUAD). Pin-bound: W rv/rrow/rdata 2,152, E wq 2,248 at ~6 pins/um -> 388.8 um faces; width 142.56 for the 94.8 um table macro with >= 20 um channels; N F20 bus + straps + status. ~11.3k writer flops + collar. The RTL registers every input at its pin and every output is a flop; pin_reg_split gives each replicated wq data pin its own launch flop: 0 added edges (calendar fire edge unchanged; rv(t) -> wq slot0 at t+3). rst_n lands on one local reset-release flop.

job.purpose: faces4 native-capture successor: core clk CTS inserts repeaters every 40 um (c8e94d78d NE N-face leaf clkbuf_leaf_528 98 ps on a ~110 um hop -> boundary TT 308..374, 164 late cfg/desc input flops got 6 BUFx2 hold pads, native capture 213.2).

pin_regs.reason: every input lands in a source pin flop (F20 bus in the folded collar pin rung, tgt/quad strap flops, rv/rrow/rdata/sm_fault/sm_sched_fault pin flops, rst_n local reset-release flop) and every output is a source flop (wq o_*, collar configured/fault/active); pin_reg_split duplicates the launch flop per replicated wq data pin

structural_change: The compactr3 failed the authoritative0.096um/0.60 pin-capacity audit before adoption. r4 returns to original388.8um face, and partitions each face clock into two actual half-face roots. Input control fields split at4SMs to preserve unique source-clock ownership. Body/core and one raw calendar clock are separate. Literal windows reserve all six clock entries; every data window cut<=0.60. Zero ordinary data/calendar stages added. Physical/native/typed grant still pending. f4db40 (Claude H-SM 1815): core clk CTS -distance_between_buffers 40 so no clock net strings an unbuffered ~110 um hop to the N-face cfg/desc capture row (c8e94d78d: 98 ps leaf vs 32 ps elsewhere -> 66 ps late flops -> 6 hold BUFx2 per input -> native capture 213.2 > 190).
